summary: Iteration 61 full-stack regression: 8/8 backend pytest cases PASS + manual curl train-from-otc PASS. Frontend MLLabPage and PocketOptionPage TMScriptStatusCard fully functional with all 13 critical data-testids present, tab switching works, no console errors. minor.issue: Slow response (~27s) due to scanning 53 OTC symbols. Functional but worth caching.

After supervisor reload the scheduler.running flag returns false until 90s grace window passes. Not a bug per design (auto-start delay) — recommend the UI's running indicator handle the transient false gracefully.

Recurring backend.err.log: 'X has 97 features, but RobustScaler is expecting 90 features as input.' This is a stray legacy predict path (NOT predict_with_tuner_pipeline) called from somewhere — does not affect /api/signals/force-generate-v2 or /api/ml/tuning-report, but pollutes logs. Likely the iter61 changes did not break this; pre-existing latent issue in maximized_ai_ml_system.py L750 vs RobustScaler n_features_in_=90 mismatch.

action_items: (LOW) Investigate stray maximized_ai_ml_system.predict() call site that feeds 97 raw features into a 90-feat RobustScaler — pollutes backend.err.log every few seconds. Look at every call to maximized_ai_ml.predict that bypasses predict_with_tuner_pipeline.
(OPTIONAL) Cache /api/ml/tuning-report (TTL ~30s) — currently O(53 symbols × Mongo aggregate) ≈ 27s response which can timeout if backend is also doing a scan.
